gen-gf-gugi-gf-anek-tamil: Gugi stands tall and cut open, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals while every curve follows the stem. Anek Tamil, a sans with big round bowls, keeps a long run of text loose and easy going.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-anek-telugu: Distinctive and bold, Gugi draws its round forms with compass-pencil consistency, while Anek Telugu brings wide, tall bowls that stay unsealed. One sets a firm mark; the other lets the lines breathe.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-anuphan: Tall, cut-open and unmistakable: Gugi builds its uppercase from lines of one constant thickness. And Anuphan, with big round bowls and clear gaps, does the quieter work of being read.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-arimo: A pipe-cleaner feel runs through every Gugi letterform, while its lowercase nearly touches the capitals and the ends stay cut open. Arimo steadies it with a tall mean line and open gaps in rounds.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-armata: Tall and cut open: Gugi swaps hairline joins for full-width stroke connections. The sharpest thing here is how those solid joins sit against Armata, a sans-serif whose wide gaps between characters let the lowercase fill its height.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-athiti: Distinctive Gugi leads, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. Athiti, a sans-serif with a high mean line and a see-through gap in each s, carries paragraph after paragraph at a friendly pace.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Atkinson Hyperlegible reads approachably, with wide-set terminals on its s and capitals that feel clipped next to the lowercase. And Gugi does the head-turning, its s spine matching its terminals in thickness.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-mon: Approachable, sans-serif Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono stretches its spacing wide. What stands out most is the line: Gugi's flat, sign-painter's-stencil weight against open counters that breathe into the white space.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-biryani: Gugi's lowercase climbs almost to the capitals, with terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. Biryani, a sans with a large eye on every e and no stroke modulation at all, keeps paragraphs unclogged.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-blinker: Tall, bold and distinctive: Gugi lifts its lowercase nearly to cap height, terminals cut open. And Blinker, a sans-serif with open apertures, would sit nicely a few sizes down from the heading.
